vscode.workspace-view.part-of-a-project-: Part of a project name, a task name or a language. Enter keeps it, Escape puts the view back.
vscode.workspace-view.add-the-monosmith-: Add the MonoSmith agent and smith’s MCP server to this folder
vscode.workspace-view.writes-claude-agen: Writes .claude/agents/smith.md, .mcp.json and .vscode/mcp.json. It shows the files first and asks.
vscode.workspace-view.run-all-its-tasks-: Run all its tasks from the context menu.
vscode.workspace-view.the-one-smith-run-: , the one smith run build builds
vscode.workspace-view.the-default-ci-and: (the default: CI and releases build this one)
vscode.workspace-view.remove-it-with-the: {name}{part}. Remove it with the minus button; its .env file stays.
vscode.workspace-view.the-environments-i: The environments {project} is built for. Add one with the plus button.
vscode.workspace-view.cache-hit-the-resu: Cache hit: the result came from the cache, nothing ran.
vscode.workspace-view.its-output-is-kept: Its output is kept: use Show Output.
